name: YNX Wallet
title: YNX Wallet — Android 1.0.3 Testnet Preview
description: Android 1.0.3 Testnet Preview source 3ab8c24c adds a direct retry after a failed authoritative Testnet read. It was installed, cold-started twice and biometrically unlocked on Android API 36, then displayed a real YNX Testnet balance, nonce and activity. It is local-test-signed only, not production signed or store released.
